summary: Quince Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notice that it regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (closing bid price at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days through April 24, 2026). The filing also discloses an ongoing deficiency with the market value of listed securities requirement, with a cure period through September 14, 2026. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic transactions are involved. The filing merely documents the status of Nasdaq listing standards.
